entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this piece of junk jersey I bought. This is absolutely ridiculous.
I'm very sorry for the wait time, and I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your item. I can certainly help you with that. Could I please get your order number to start?

It's VF-774-901. And let me tell you, I've been a VIP customer for years, and this is the worst quality I've ever seen from you guys. I'm one step away from cancelling everything and telling everyone I know to avoid VeloFit.

I understand your frustration, and I appreciate you bringing this to my attention. I see the order for the ClubFit Jersey here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

It's the wrong size! I ordered my usual large, but the jersey is so impossibly tight I can barely get it on. It feels two sizes too small. I want to return it, and I want a full refund, not some store credit nonsense.
Of course. It's no good if the gear doesn't fit correctly. Let me just check the purchase date for you... okay, I see it was delivered 78 days ago. One moment while I confirm our policy.
I don't care when it was delivered! Are you going to fix this or do I need to speak to a manager? Because this is my last call before I light you up on social media.

That won't be necessary, sir. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can process a full refund for you right now. I can also process an exchange for a larger size if you'd prefer.
A full refund, back to my card? No hidden fees?

Absolutely. A full refund to your original payment method, with no fees. And for the inconvenience and as a thank you for being a loyal VIP member, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now.
Oh. Well... okay. A full refund and a credit? That's... acceptable. I appreciate you taking care of that. Send the label over.
The email is on its way. Once we receive the jersey back at our warehouse, the refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and we hope to see you again soon.
